consistency: Verify bytes after successful file close and retained process restart; in-flight hflush/publication semantics pending.
atomicity: No transaction or multi-file atomicity claimed.
idempotency: No transparent mutation retry; repeated PUT to existing path is rejected.
durability: RF1, one NameNode and DataNode; retained Docker volumes on one host. No metadata HA or disk-loss guarantee.
retry: Native HDFS CLI behavior; harness does not reseed during restart verification.
payload: One 64 MiB deterministic incompressible binary file, RNG seed 42193.
client: Native HDFS CLI, independent SHA-256 of streamed body and physical block.
